# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Currently, only the latest version on the `main` branch is supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| main    | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report any security vulnerabilities by opening an issue on the repository or contacting the maintainers directly. Do not disclose sensitive security vulnerabilities publicly until they have been patched.
